_comment: Example only, for an imaginary 'trip planner from a voice note' idea. The kickoff writes the real one to kickoff/backlog.json.

beads.title: Serve the contract stubs from the API so the frontend can build against them
beads.description: Mount the fixed-data stubs from contracts/stubs behind the real routes in api/ until each route is implemented.
beads.acceptance: test_stub_routes_match_schema in api/tests/test_contracts.py passes for every route in contracts/api.openapi.yaml

beads.title: POST /trips creates a trip from a transcript
beads.description: Implement the create-trip route in api/routes/trips.py per contracts/api.openapi.yaml, storing to the trips table.
beads.acceptance: test_create_trip_returns_201 and test_create_trip_rejects_empty_transcript in api/tests/test_trips.py pass

beads.title: Turn a transcript into a day-by-day itinerary with the LLM
beads.description: ai/itinerary.py: prompt + parser returning the Itinerary type from contracts/. Fixed instructions first for prompt caching; fake client in tests.
beads.acceptance: test_itinerary_parses_fixture_response in ai/tests/test_itinerary.py passes using the recorded fixture

beads.title: Trip page renders an itinerary from the stub API
beads.description: web/app/trips/[id]: day cards per the DEMO.md step 3 sketch, reading GET /trips/{id} from the stub.
beads.acceptance: trip-page.spec.ts Playwright test shows 3 day cards for the seeded trip

beads.title: Expected-failure tests for the trip routes against the contract
beads.description: Tester bead: strict xfail tests for every trip route response shape, naming the bead that will make each pass.
beads.acceptance: api/tests/test_trip_contract.py exists, runs in make test, and every test is xfail(strict=True) with a bead id

beads.title: Seed script for the demo trip and user
beads.description: scripts/seed_demo.py creates the exact records DEMO.md uses, idempotently.
